findings.evidence: Polynomial.lean:164-177 and Moments.lean eq_fiberCount have identical proof bodies (`have hm := ...; have he := congrArg (fun v => A *ᵥ v) (hsolve.trans hm.symm); simpa only [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hA, Matrix.one_mulVec] using he`); mulVec_signCount at line 147 already shows the required cast/simp bridge (`Int.cast_sum, Int.cast_prod, Int.cast_pow, SignType.intCast_cast, signCount_eq_fiberCount`) turns the polynomial statement into the fiberCount one. Grep of ./mathlib for `mulVec_injective` finds only square/unit/det-based cancellation, so the general TauCeti lemma is the right home for the argument.
findings.fix: Derive eq_signCount as `eq_fiberCount (fun x : Z => fun j => sign ((Q j).eval x.val)) columns hinj (fun x => cover x.1 x.2) (fun i σ => ∏ j, (σ j : K) ^ rows i j) A hA proposed (hsolve.trans (funext fun i => by simp only [signSum_prod_pow, Int.cast_sum, Int.cast_prod, Int.cast_pow, SignType.intCast_cast]))` (conclusion is rfl-equal to the signCount form via signCount_eq_fiberCount), and derive solution_pos_iff from pos_iff_exists with the same instantiation plus Subtype.exists to rewrite `∃ x : Z` to `∃ x ∈ Z`.
findings.issue: eq_signCount repeats the three-line proof of the general eq_fiberCount (mulVec_signCount, congrArg (A *ᵥ ·), mulVec_mulVec/hA/one_mulVec) rather than deriving the special case; solution_pos_iff at line 181 likewise re-proves pos_iff_exists (eq_signCount + signCount_pos) instead of instantiating it.

summary: Hypotheses are at the natural level (every assumption is forced by signHom, Polynomial.roots, or Nat.cast_pos, and the moment algebra is over a bare Semiring), but the polynomial layer re-proves the general left-inverse cancellation argument instead of instantiating it.
